_comment: The shipped retail ontology (D9). Layer 2 of docs/plan/domain-knowledge-layers.md.
Types and concepts only, never instances. A concept describes what a Quote IS; no quote
Built by us, once, and judged by a retail practitioner reading it. The test to apply
before adding a concept: would a retail practitioner at any customer recognise this
without being told which business we built it for? A concept true of only one
deployment belongs in that deployment's overlay, not here.
business_area must be a term in vocabularies.json. Synonyms are the words people
actually use; question_patterns are how they ask. Both are embedded with the concept,
which is what makes a question reach it without naming it.

concepts.name: Customer
concepts.description: A person or organisation that buys, or has bought, from the business.

concepts.name: CustomerSegment
concepts.description: A defined grouping of customers that behave similarly or are treated similarly for analysis and targeting.

concepts.name: Contact
concepts.description: A named individual at a customer organisation, who may enquire, request a quote or place an order.
question_patterns: which people are we talking to?

concepts.name: Product
concepts.description: An individual item offered for sale, identified by a stock keeping unit.

concepts.name: ProductCategory
concepts.description: A grouping of products in the merchandising hierarchy, such as a department, range or product line.

concepts.name: Brand
concepts.description: The manufacturer brand a product is sold under. A business may carry many brands, and customers often shop by brand rather than by category.
question_patterns: which brands drive the most demand?

concepts.name: Inventory
concepts.description: The quantity of a product physically held at a location, together with the thresholds that govern replenishment.

concepts.name: StockLevel
concepts.description: A band describing how much of a product is on hand relative to its reorder point, used to decide what to reorder and what is overstocked.

concepts.name: Location
concepts.description: A physical place where inventory is held or from which sales are made, such as a store, warehouse, branch or region.

concepts.name: Supplier
concepts.description: An organisation that supplies products to the business, whose reliability and lead time affect availability.
question_patterns: who do we buy this from?

concepts.name: PurchaseOrder
concepts.description: An order the business places on a supplier to replenish stock.
question_patterns: what have we got on order?

concepts.name: Delivery
concepts.description: A consignment received from a supplier against a purchase order, recording what arrived and when relative to what was promised.

concepts.name: Order
concepts.description: A confirmed purchase by a customer, covering one or more products at agreed prices.
question_patterns: how many orders did we take?
what is the average order value?

concepts.name: OrderLine
concepts.description: One product line within an order, carrying the quantity and the price at which that product was sold.
question_patterns: how many units of this were sold?

concepts.name: QuoteRequest
concepts.description: A request from a prospective buyer for a price on one or more products, before any commitment to buy.
question_patterns: how many quote requests came in?
which products get the most enquiries?

concepts.name: Quote
concepts.description: A priced response to a quote request, which may or may not convert into an order.
question_patterns: what is our quote conversion rate?
how many quotes turned into orders?

concepts.name: Return
concepts.description: Goods sent back by a customer after purchase, with the reason recorded.
question_patterns: what is being returned and why?

concepts.name: Campaign
concepts.description: A marketing activity run over a period to drive demand, with a budget and a measurable outcome.

concepts.name: Channel
concepts.description: A route to market or a source of traffic, such as the web store, a rep group, a marketplace or paid search.
question_patterns: where do our customers come from?

concepts.name: WebSession
concepts.description: A single visit to the web store by one person, covering the pages viewed and the actions taken during that visit.
question_patterns: what do visitors look at before enquiring?
